questions.q: Which crystal in Scott Summers' visor lets him open his eyes safely?
questions.why: His optic beams are stopped only by eyelids or ruby quartz, so his visor uses ruby-quartz lenses.

questions.q: Which actor first played Cyclops in the 2000 film X-Men?
questions.why: James Marsden first played Cyclops in X-Men (2000).

questions.q: What is the codename of Scott's younger brother Alex Summers?
questions.why: Alex Summers, Cyclops's younger brother, is the mutant Havok.

questions.q: Who recruited Scott and named him field leader of the X-Men?
questions.why: Charles Xavier took Scott in, trained him and made him the team's field leader.

questions.q: In which year did Cyclops debut in The X-Men #1?
questions.why: The X-Men #1 carried a September 1963 cover date.

questions.q: In 1994, Cyclops married which X-Men teammate?
questions.why: Scott and Jean wed in X-Men volume 2, issue 30, dated March 1994.

questions.q: Madelyne Pryor, mother of Scott's son Nathan, first appeared in Uncanny X-Men #168 in which year?
questions.why: Madelyne Pryor, a Jean Grey clone, debuted in April 1983.

questions.q: Scott's father, Corsair, leads which band of space pirates?
questions.why: Corsair, Scott's father, leads the Starjammers.

questions.q: Whose spacecraft attacked the plane carrying young Scott's family over Alaska?
questions.why: A Shi'ar spacecraft attacked the family's plane over Alaska, orphaning Scott.

questions.q: X-Men: Schism (2011) split the team over a rift between Cyclops and which teammate?
questions.why: Disagreement over violence between Cyclops and Wolverine split the X-Men into two factions in Schism.
